correctedState: CONFIRMED, with two additions. Our dynamic-context recogniser (packages/shared/src/capabilities/runtime-skill-context.ts:19-51) implements a form Claude does not document: at most ONE command per skill, taken from a bare `!` prefix on the first non-empty, non-fenced body line (`first.startsWith('!')` at :32, so leading whitespace also disqualifies it), with `first.slice(1).trim()` at :33 keeping any backticks as part of the command string. Claude's form is an inline `` !`<command>` `` placeholder legal anywhere a `!` follows line start or whitespace (skills.md:526), unlimited in count, whose output replaces the placeholder in place (:494, :519), plus a ` ```! ` fenced block for multi-line commands (:528-536). Verified by executing the shipped function: the docs' pr-summary example and the docs' own summarize-changes quickstart both yield undefined (zero substitutions); the ` ```! ` fenced form yields undefined because the /^\s*```/ fence toggle at :24 treats it as prose; a first line of `` !`git diff HEAD` `` yields the command string "`git diff HEAD`", which SessionManager.ts:4595-4597 passes verbatim as `{ command, cwd }` to `shouldAllowToolInMode('Bash', …)` and `evaluatePermissionDslV1`, so an `allowed-tools: Bash(git diff:*)` rule cannot match it and, if approved, bash would treat it as command substitution. ADDITION 1: a skill that follows the docs and writes two placeholders where the first is at column 0 does not degrade — runtime-skill-context.ts:48 throws `runtime-skill-context-command-ambiguous`, and base-agent.ts:2412 does not catch it, so the whole turn fails. ADDITION 2: output is appended as a separate context block (`outputs.join('\n\n')`, base-agent.ts:2446, folded into `messageParts` at :2805), so even a recognised command's output arrives detached from the prose that referenced it. Separately (already tracked elsewhere in the sweep), the path runs only when `capabilityTurnRuntime.provider === 'pi'` and only for skills carrying `pluginRuntime` (base-agent.ts:2407, :2411), so user, project and all Claude-backend skills execute nothing.
